title: Cartograph capability envelope v1
description: The response every `carto` command emits on stdout under --format json. Emitted on failure too, with ok:false. Nothing but this document may be written to stdout in json mode; logs go to stderr.

schema.description: Envelope version. Lets skills pin behaviour across upgrades.

ok.description: Whether the command succeeded. Empty results are a SUCCESS (ok:true), not an error.

tool.description: The logical operation, e.g. review-context. Stable across CLI renames.

data.description: Typed per tool — never an opaque blob. List-shaped results use {items, summary?, facets?}.

truncated.description: This response was deliberately incomplete. Truncation is SEMANTIC (lowest-ranked results dropped), never a byte cut.

truncated_reason.description: Tells the agent whether to narrow the query (max_tokens) or request the next page (page_limit).

size.description: A budget signal, not a tokenizer match for any specific model.

tokens_estimated.description: Conservative and monotonic with output size, covering the serialised envelope.

provenance.description: What state produced this answer. Cursors are bound to it so a page cannot silently continue against a rebuilt graph.

page.description: Present on list-shaped results. At most ONE collection per envelope is pageable — a cursor could not be interpreted unambiguously otherwise.

collection.description: Which collection pages, when data is composite rather than a plain item list. Omit when paging data.items.

next_cursor.description: Opaque, versioned, and bound to the query hash plus the provenance snapshot.

search_mode.description: Required on any search-like result. Degradation to keyword/FTS5 must never be silent.

code.description: Mirrors the exit code: 1 usage, 2 precondition, 3 internal.

remediation.description: Required for precondition errors. An actionable command that lets the agent self-heal, e.g. 'run: carto build'.
